title: An open-addressing set
description:
Write a hash set that stores items directly in an array, with linear probing.

```
insert 10 keys, capacity 16, longest probe 3
contains(42): true, contains(7): false
erase(42), contains(42): false, size 9
```
hints: `erase` marks the slot `deleted`, not `empty`, so searches keep probing past it (lesson 2.04).
When growing, insert every used slot again into the new array; deleted slots are dropped.
requirements: `class IntSet` with `insert`, `contains`, `erase` and `size`; slots are empty, used or deleted (a "tombstone").
Grow to twice the size when more than 70% full.
stretch: Try quadratic probing and compare the longest probe.
